text:
@bot Hi Grok Bot team. I published Feedback Theme Tally, a public template:
https://x.ai/bot/ETwbAVBi1bweFPvBqWC2E

It codes a batch of customer feedback against one theme list the user approves, with counts you can trace back to the exact words. Draft only. It masks names, emails, and phone numbers and sends nothing.

Would like it considered for the marketplace, under Operations or Product, pretty please.
